items.name: vintage-theme
items.title: Vintage Theme
items.description: Dark, warm vintage audio equipment theme with gold accents and metallic surfaces.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-base
items.title: Vintage Base
items.description: Complete vintage audio equipment design system. Dark surfaces, gold labels, metallic hardware, warm accents.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: use-knob-drag
items.title: useKnobDrag
items.description: Hook for drag-to-rotate knob interaction with vertical mouse sensitivity.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-button
items.title: Vintage Button
items.description: Skeuomorphic push button with press animation and LED indicator.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-slider
items.title: Vintage Slider
items.description: Horizontal fader with gradient fill bar and metallic thumb.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-meter
items.title: Vintage Meter
items.description: Analog VU meter with SVG arc, animated needle, and color gradient scale.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-knob
items.title: Vintage Knob
items.description: Small rotary knob with drag interaction, tick marks, and value labels.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-large-knob
items.title: Vintage Large Knob
items.description: Large rotary knob with metallic conic-gradient surface and drag interaction.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-toggle
items.title: Vintage Toggle
items.description: 3-position toggle switch (up/middle/down) with metallic housing.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-eq
items.title: Vintage EQ
items.description: Graphic equalizer with multiple vertical faders and metallic handles.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-led
items.title: Vintage LED
items.description: Status LED indicator with glow effect in green, red, yellow, or orange.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-command-palette
items.title: Vintage Command Palette
items.description: Ctrl+K command menu with search, groups, keyboard navigation, and vintage styling.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-tv-frame
items.title: Vintage TV Frame
items.description: Retro CRT television frame with bezels, scanlines, vignette, power button, and LED.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-soundboard-pad
items.title: Vintage Soundboard Pad
items.description: Trigger pad with color, icon, label, glow effect, and press animation.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-xy-pad
items.title: Vintage XY Pad
items.description: 2D controller surface with crosshair cursor, grid lines, and axis readouts.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: vintage-oscilloscope
items.title: Vintage Oscilloscope
items.description: Canvas-based waveform and FFT spectrum display with CRT scanline effect.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Faixa contínua com variantes fade, band, tilt e reverse. Pausa em hover, foco e fora da tela. Sem cor própria: pinta com os tokens da marca.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: rail
items.title: Rail
items.description: Trilho horizontal com scroll-snap nativo e setas que desabilitam nas pontas. Zero biblioteca, arrasta no toque.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: plate
items.title: Plate
items.description: Placa para foto de catálogo recortada sobre branco. Multiply casa a foto com o fundo sem recorte novo.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Pastilha de filtro com aria-pressed e contagem que nunca renderiza zero. Aceita um SVG de dado dentro, herdando currentColor.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: sticky-filterbar
items.title: Sticky Filterbar
items.description: Barra de filtro que gruda e condensa. Mede a altura real do cabeçalho em --header-h, porque ela muda com o viewport e com o carregamento da fonte.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: store-status
items.title: Store Status
items.description: Aberto/fechado de loja fisica resolvido no fuso DA LOJA. Nao renderiza nada ate o JS confirmar — nada na tela e melhor que horario errado na tela.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: measure-picker
items.title: Measure Picker
items.description: Pergunte a medida que o cliente SABE (altura) e devolva o codigo do produto (tamanho). input[type=range] de verdade: teclado e leitor de tela de graca.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: motion-layer
items.title: Motion Layer
items.description: Camada de movimento ligada por data-* (reveal, parallax, magnetic) com o ciclo de vida do editor de tema Shopify. GSAP + ScrollTrigger.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: kanban
items.title: Kanban
items.description: Board com drag-and-drop, selecao por marquee sobre o vazio e multi-selecao com shift/ctrl. Colhido do visant-board.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Tabela densa para superficie de trabalho: ordenacao, selecao e edicao inline. 800 linhas ja resolvidas.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Alternador de poucas opcoes. Substitui um select quando as opcoes cabem na tela.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: octahedron-loader
items.title: Octahedron Loader
items.description: Loader geometrico da casa. Distintivo sem virar mascote.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline Edit
items.description: Editar no lugar em vez de abrir modal. Menos clique por item numa fila.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Linha do tempo de eventos, densa e sem enfeite.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: assignee-stack
items.title: Assignee Stack
items.description: Pilha de avatares com estouro contado. Componente de time.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: repulsive-hover
items.title: Repulsive Hover
items.description: Elemento que foge do cursor. Interacao pura, zero dado.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: smooth-scroll-provider
items.title: Smooth Scroll Provider
items.description: Lenis + GSAP num relogio so, com bail-out em prefers-reduced-motion. A instancia sai por callback, sem impor store.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: glitch-chars
items.title: Glitch Chars
items.description: Dois caracteres que trocam sozinhos: o sinal de vida mais barato de um estado de espera.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: status-ticker
items.title: Status Ticker
items.description: Linha de status para espera longa: ruido, verbo que gira e cronometro. Para quando nao existe progresso real para medir.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: turbulence-field
items.title: Turbulence Field
items.description: Nevoa procedural em SVG feTurbulence. Escala para grades inteiras sem gastar contexto WebGL.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: working-glyph
items.title: Working Glyph
items.description: Icone que bate com faiscas: mostra esforco em vez de pedir paciencia.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

.working-glyph-shine::before.background-image: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 40%, color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 45%, transparent) 50%, transparent 60%)

items.name: paper-shuttle
items.title: Paper Shuttle
items.description: Loader de transferencia: papeis voando de uma pasta para outra. Conta a operacao sem uma palavra.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: generating-tile
items.title: Generating Tile
items.description: A superficie canonica de isto esta sendo gerado. Tres variantes: tile, inline e overlay.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: masonry-gallery
items.title: Masonry Gallery
items.description: Masonry round-robin: anexar pagina nunca reflui o que ja esta na tela. Para feed infinito de aspect ratio misto.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: scrub-input
items.title: Scrub Input
items.description: Campo numerico que se arrasta. Arrasto, roda, setas e duplo-clique no mesmo valor, com shift para passo fino.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: grid-dots
items.title: Grid Dots
items.description: Malha de pontos de fundo em um gradiente repetido. Zero nos no DOM, inverte sozinha com o tema.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: drop-overlay
items.title: Drop Overlay
items.description: Alvo de soltar arquivo. O estado que todo mundo esquece de desenhar no drag-and-drop.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: brand-theme
items.title: Brand Theme Runtime
items.description: Aplica em runtime o tema compilado de uma brand guideline do Visant Labs. Provider, hook e a folha de estilo unica que troca a marca sem recarregar.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>

items.name: brand-selector
items.title: Brand Selector
items.description: Seletor de marca com previa ao percorrer: paleta, par tipografico e completude do vault na propria linha. Le /r/brands.json e aplica o tema da marca escolhida.
items.author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>
